thread:
nina: Hey finance — stayed at Marriott last week, they placed a $200 incidental auth on the corp card and later posted a $25 minibar charge. My statement shows both the $200 hold and a refund for $200, but the posted $25 didn't net correctly. Can someone confirm if we need to submit a separate receipt for the $25 or if this is auto-reconciled?

alex_finance: @nina there are two things — holds vs posted charges. Holds are usually released by the hotel; we don't reimburse holds. If the $25 posted, we need the itemized receipt (or hotel folio) to match the line. Did you get an email folio?

nina: I have an email folio but it's missing the item breakdown, only total + tax. Hotel front desk said minibar was on a separate machine and they emailed a separate receipt but i can't find it.

sam: If it's just $25, we can do a manual PO/expense note, but policy wants an itemized receipt. Try requesting a folio reprint from the hotel — they usually can provide a CSV of charges.

nina: I reached out, they said they can reissue. Could I upload the folio to Expensify? or do we need anything else?

alex_finance: Upload to Expensify, tag it with "hotel-incidentals". If hotel can't provide itemized, we accept an affidavit only for < $50 once per quarter — but need manager approval. Who's your manager?

nina: Jordan is my manager. @jordan fyi — can you approve an affidavit if needed?

jordan: I can approve if the hotel can't produce it; please add details (date, merchant, amount) in the expense notes.

travel-ops: FYI hotels sometimes post auths late; if you see both a $200 hold and a $200 reversal and there's no net in final posting, it's fine. The key is matching posted charges (like the $25).

alex_finance: If you want, I can pre-create a ticket so we don't lose this. finance-bot: new ticket #824: hotel-incidentals-nina

finance-bot: Ticket #824 created and assigned to alex_finance

nina: Thanks — i'll upload folio when hotel sends, otherwise will submit affidavit and request approval.

alex_finance: Sounds good. If the hotel reissues, upload and we'll close ticket. If not, submit affidavit + manager approval screenshot and we'll do manual reimbursement. :thumbsup:

nina: Great, thanks all :heart:
